name: flatcall
axis: static direct call to a tiny leaf function, 1.2e9 times — the CALL half of the call-vs-inline pair
notes: PAIR WITH bench/recursion/flatcall-inlined (identical loop, body written out). time(flatcall) - time(flatcall-inlined) is the per-call cost of a static call to a tiny leaf, and it is the number that matters most in this category. Two structural decisions were forced by measurement: (1) `acc` feeds the NEXT iteration's argument so the loop is a true serial dependency chain — a first draft that accumulated with xor+mask was VOID because rustc vectorized the reduction (400M iters in 44ms, 0.11ns/iter); (2) the inner bound is capped at 600M and the work is reached with an outer x2, because `(acc ^ i) * 3` must stay inside i32 in all four languages. Scale-verified. Interleaved min-of-3 on core 6 (loaded machine, so read the RATIOS): rust 1.953s, deno 2.460s, vl 2.917s, python(12M) 1.864s.
result: PER-CALL OVERHEAD IS ZERO IN ALL THREE COMPILED RUNTIMES. flatcall minus flatcall-inlined: rust -0.014s, deno +0.007s, vl +0.004s — all within noise over 1.2e9 calls (VL's works out to 0.003ns/call). All three inline the leaf; VL is NOT paying a static-call penalty. CPython is the only one that pays: +0.534s over 12M calls = ~44ns/call. opt.vl is the in-function (locals) spelling: 2.940s vs main.vl's 2.917s, i.e. 0.8% SLOWER — the documented top-level-let GLOBAL cliff does NOT appear on this shape.
vlGap: VL is 1.49x slower than rust and 1.19x slower than deno on BOTH halves equally, so the gap is the loop BODY, not the call. wasm-dis of VL's module shows a textbook loop — two i32 locals, block/loop/br_if, i32.xor/mul/add/and, no allocation, no bounds checks — so VL's EMIT is optimal and the residual is the wasmtime/Cranelift JIT floor against LLVM and TurboFan on a scalar dependency chain. `vl build -O3` changes nothing here (1.591s vs 1.606s, 0.9%), consistent with the emitted wasm already being minimal.

startupBaselineSeconds._measured: min-of-10, empty program, taskset -c 6, contended 24-core i9-12900KF

compileTime._note: compile time, measured separately and never inside an execution number

consolidatedRun._method: single interleaved pass over ALL 8 recursion benchmarks, min-of-3, taskset -c 6, per-runtime empty-program startup subtracted, machine contended by other agents (loadavg ~10) so read the RATIOS not the absolutes
